prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D Arsene character draft for a Persona 5 Joker mod, revised after user feedback. Image 1 is the original Arsene model render, design reference only. Image 2 is the approved Joker illustration, reference ONLY for bold clean ink and cel-shaded 2D drawing style, do not draw Joker. Draw official Persona 5 Arsene with his red fitted tailcoat, black top hat, red-and-black beaked demonic mask head, white cravat, black waistcoat, gold buttons and hanging chains, red high-heeled boots, two huge black feathered wings with dark crimson inner feathers. USER CORRECTION: avoid an overly long thin stretched body and awkward contorted posture. Make the torso and legs appreciably more compact, chest and shoulders wider, limbs clearly jointed and believable, head about one seventh to one eighth of the complete body height including hat, not a tiny head on extremely long legs. Elegant athletic proportions, not skinny stilt legs, not giant hands. New pose: a calm, balanced upright hovering spellcaster, three-quarter FRONT toward screen right, torso upright and untwisted, shoulders level, hips aligned under ribcage. Two legs hang naturally beneath the hips, knees slightly bent, separated so neither leg crosses or wraps around the other, both boots visible. One arm extends toward screen right at lower-chest height with a gentle elbow bend and a relaxed open casting hand (fingers naturally curved, not a huge claw lunging into the lens); other arm hangs slightly outward, elbow softly bent and hand relaxed. Both wings open in a balanced, broad shallow V behind him, full feather silhouettes comfortably INSIDE the canvas, no wingtip cutoff. Tailcoat tails hang and sweep gently behind, chains follow gravity. Draw a polished OFFICIAL P5-like HAND-DRAWN CEL illustration with crisp bold black outlines, flat crimson/black/white colors and hard graphic shadows, matching Image 2. NO 3D rendering, no photoreal textures or glossy plastic, no extreme fisheye/foreshortening. Portrait canvas 1536 by 2048. Leave a clear transparent margin on every side, keep the entire hat, both wings, boots, chains and coat visible. Genuine transparent RGBA PNG, alpha 0 outside the single character. No backdrop, ground, cast shadow, VFX, glow, particles, text, sheets or extra characters.
